item.title: Pilot stabs co-pilot in apparent attempt to crash Israel-bound Flydubai flight; passengers intervene
item.description: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, on Wednesday after a pilot stabbed the co-pilot in an apparent attempt to crash the plane, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The Boeing 737, Flight FZ1073, was carrying mostly Israeli passengers when…

item.title: Russia launches largest attack on Ukraine's energy grid since spring, killing at least seven
item.description: Russia launched its largest attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure since the spring, primarily targeting Kyiv and the surrounding region, Ukraine's Prime Minister said. At least five people were killed in overnight strikes across the country, including a child in the Kyiv region, officials…

item.title: Supreme Court allows Trump's third-country deportation policy to proceed for now
item.description: The case concerns how much procedural protection immigrants must receive before the U.S. government can deport them to a country other than the one specified in their original removal order—so-called 'third-country removals.' item.title: Trump signs executive order renaming AI to 'Super Intelligence' as tech leaders ink voluntary safety accord

item.title: MLB Wild Card Series Day 1: Padres, Yankees, White Sox, Braves take 1-0 leads

item.title: Measles outbreaks spread across multiple states; CDC death tally lags Pennsylvania's count
